name: Campingpark Oberammergau
beschreibung: The Campingpark Oberammergau is located in the municipality of Oberammergau of the same name, which lies in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by a picturesque Alpine landscape that offers ideal conditions for extended walks and challenging mountain tours. The site itself impresses with modern infrastructure, well-maintained sanitary facilities, and clearly demarcated pitches for motorhomes and tents. The amenities also include a small supermarket and a restaurant that serves regional Schmankerln. The quiet and family-friendly atmosphere makes the Campingpark a popular destination for nature lovers and those seeking relaxation alike. It appeals above all to campers who appreciate a well-kept pitch with direct access to the mountains.
